source: Instructor upload ESP32-S3_Zero.step; 31 solid component objects retained unscaled. 18 x 23.5 mm PCB, 2.54 mm terminal pitch and 15.24 mm row spacing verified in geometry.
appearance: Latest instructor photo: black PCB, gold terminal pads, silver USB-C shell, red antenna. Earlier WROOM upload contains no stored RGB styles; appearance is interpreted from photo, not copied from it.

headers.style: Long centred male headers, upper ends untrimmed for expansion
headers.reference: Purchased PENGLIN B0FJ5NR96F; installed S3 header brand not confirmed
headers.width_evidence: Provisional to fit source 0.9 mm circular bores; not a measured pin section

socket_reference: Youmile B0C13N6T48; installed origin unknown. Housing height 8.5 mm and cavity depth 7 mm remain provisional. Simplified hollow contacts, not recovered spring geometry.

placement.usb_direction: Toward A / carrier outside edge; inferred

steps.instruction: Prepare two nine-pin long centred male strips. Retain original spacers and full upper ends.
Solder both male strips to the S3 with original spacers against its underside. Leave the upper pins available for expansion.
Fit two nine-way female sockets at A11-I11 and A17-I17 and solder underneath the carrier.
Seat the S3 male strips in the carrier-fixed sockets, plastic-to-plastic. S3, male pins, spacers and top solder detach together.

publication_status: Uploaded source and native comparison retained locally; redistribution permission not established. Scripts, records and geometry checks versioned.
